entries.surface: webhook `X-openwop-Signature` value without the `sha256=` prefix, and the `X-openwop-*` header family generally
entries.authority: v2 charter program C.4 (proposal only): every non-standard header becomes `OpenWOP-*`; signature headers dual-emit through the overlap
entries.replacement: `OpenWOP-Signature: sha256={hex}` (+ the v1 header, dual-emitted until the v1 deprecation date)
entries.note: The corrected form `sha256={hex}` is the current normative one (webhooks.md §Delivery headers). Hosts that emitted a bare hex value were corrected in place (INTEROP-MATRIX 2026-08-24), not deprecated. The SDKs' `openwop-Webhook-Signature: v1=` header does not appear in this corpus at all and is an SDK-versus-spec defect tracked in openwop-sdks, not a deprecation here.

entries.surface: `409 interrupt_already_resolved` (interrupt.md) and `410 interrupt_gone` (interrupt-profiles.md) for an invalidated interrupt token
entries.authority: v2 charter program C.4 (error registry): one code per condition
entries.replacement: one registered code for "token invalidated", chosen by the C.4 child RFC
entries.note: Not a deprecation today: both codes are live and normative in different documents for overlapping conditions (a token invalidated by resolution or cancel). Recorded here so the overlap is not lost before the error registry decides it.
